# mdpdf

mdpdf converts Markdown files into PDFs from the command line. It doesn't need a browser engine or a LaTeX install, and setup takes almost no steps.

It's written in Go and ships as a single 8 MB binary. Download it, put it on your `PATH`, and you can start converting. Since everything is in that one file, it behaves the same on a laptop, in a CI pipeline or in a small container image.

It renders 100 pages in 1.2 seconds, so PDF conversion won't slow down a build step, even with a large documentation set or automatically generated reports. It's also easy to script and add to tools you already use.

mdpdf is open source under the MIT License, so you can use, modify and distribute it in personal or commercial projects. Bug reports, feature requests and contributions are welcome.
